text: Yes, early check-in is possible at Beach Resort from 12:00 PM for $30, if the room is ready [1]. It is not guaranteed [1][2]. Platinum members can check in from 1:00 PM at no charge, subject to availability [1]. The standard check-in time is 3:00 PM [3].

cited_texts.text:
Flexible rate: free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival. Cancellations inside 48 hours are charged one night plus tax.
Non-refundable rate: no refunds or date changes under any circumstances, except when approved by the General Manager.
Open 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily. Guests must be 18 or older. Book at least 24 hours ahead. Cancellations within 12 hours are charged 50% of the treatment price.

text: Under the brand standards, flexible rates allow free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival, and cancellations inside 48 hours are charged one night plus tax. Non-refundable rates allow no refunds or date changes unless the General Manager approves [1]. For Beach Resort spa treatments, cancellations within 12 hours are charged 50% of the treatment price [2]. The documents I have don't include a Beach Resort-specific room cancellation policy, so please check with a manager on that.

cited_texts.text: All properties in the group are 100% non-smoking, including balconies and patios. A $250 cleaning fee is charged when there is evidence of smoking in a room.

text: No, guests cannot smoke on the balcony. All properties in the group are 100% non-smoking, including balconies and patios [1]. The same policy also charges a $250 cleaning fee when there is evidence of smoking in a room [1].

cited_texts.section: Beach Resort - Property Policies > Airport Transfers
cited_texts.text:
Pickup from MIA: sedan $65 one way (up to 3 guests), SUV $95 one way (up to 6 guests). Book at least 24 hours in advance.
We do not offer transfers from Fort Lauderdale (FLL). Recommend a taxi or rideshare.

text: Yes, for pickups from Miami International (MIA): a sedan costs $65 one way for up to 3 guests, and an SUV costs $95 one way for up to 6 guests. Book at least 24 hours in advance [1]. The sources don't mention a shared shuttle or describe other transfer types, so check with a manager on that. There are no transfers from Fort Lauderdale (FLL), and the hotel recommends a taxi or rideshare for that airport [1].

cited_texts.section: Hotel Group Guest Handbook > Luggage Storage
cited_texts.text: The front desk stores luggage free of charge before check-in and after check-out on the same day. Bags are tagged and kept in a locked room behind the front desk. Luggage cannot be stored overnight after check-out.

text: You can leave luggage at the front desk, which stores bags free of charge after check-out on the same day. Bags are tagged and kept in a locked room behind the front desk. Luggage cannot be stored overnight after check-out [1].

cited_texts.text: Same-day valet laundry and dry cleaning: drop items at the front desk by 9:00 AM for return by 6:00 PM. Prices are on the laundry card in the room. There is no self-service laundry room.

text: Yes. Same-day valet laundry and dry cleaning is available: drop items at the front desk by 9:00 AM for return by 6:00 PM, and prices are on the laundry card in the room [1]. There is no self-service laundry room [1].

cited_texts.section: Guest Handbook - Beach Resort > Quiet Hours
cited_texts.text: Quiet hours are 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Music at the rooftop pool ends when the pool closes at 10:00 PM.

text: Quiet hours are 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM [1].

cited_texts.text: Every property has accessible rooms with roll-in showers, grab bars and lowered closet rails. Visual alarm and doorbell kits are available on request. Ask for an accessible room when booking; the front desk confirms it at check-in. Service animals are always welcome.

text: Yes, accessible rooms are available. They have roll-in showers, grab bars and lowered closet rails, and you should ask for one when booking; the front desk confirms it at check-in [1]. Visual alarm and doorbell kits are available on request [1]. Beach Resort's own guidelines do not add any further detail on accessible rooms, so confirm specifics with a manager if needed.

text: The Guest Rewards program has three tiers based on nights stayed per year: Silver (5+), Gold (15+), and Platinum (40+). Late check-out is free at 1:00 PM for Silver, 2:00 PM for Gold, and guaranteed to 4:00 PM for Platinum [4]. Members earn 10 points per US dollar spent on the room rate, but taxes, resort fees and pet fees don't earn points [2]. Always confirm the member number in the guest's PMS profile before granting tier benefits [1]. The documents don't cover enrollment or point redemption, so please check with a manager on those.

cited_texts.section: Beach Resort - Property Policies > Resort Fee
cited_texts.text: $35 per night plus tax. Includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day.
Wi-Fi is included in the resort fee. Network: BeachResort-Guest. The password is printed on the key card sleeve. Coverage includes all rooms, the rooftop pool and the beach chair area.

text: The resort fee is $35 per night plus tax and includes Wi-Fi, bike rental, and two bottles of water per day [1]. Wi-Fi is covered in all rooms, the rooftop pool, and the beach chair area [2].

cited_texts.text: Open 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily. Guests must be 18 or older. Book at least 24 hours ahead. Cancellations within 12 hours are charged 50% of the treatment price.

text: The spa is open from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily [1].

cited_texts.text: Wi-Fi is free for all guests (there is no resort fee). Network: MountainLodge-Guest. The password is printed on the key card sleeve. The signal is weaker in the cabins; a free range extender is available at the front desk.

text: Yes. Wi-Fi is free for all guests, with no resort fee. The network is MountainLodge-Guest, and the password is printed on the key card sleeve. The signal is weaker in the cabins, and a free range extender is available at the front desk [1].

cited_texts.text: A continental breakfast is included in every room rate, served 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM in the Great Room. Mountain Lodge has no restaurant or room service; guests may have food delivered from local restaurants to the front desk.

text: Yes. A continental breakfast is included in every room rate and is served from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM in the Great Room [1].

text: Mountain Lodge does not have an on-site pool. Guests get free day passes to a partner fitness center 0.5 miles away, which has an indoor pool [2].

cited_texts.text: We are dog-friendly: dogs of any size, maximum 2 per room. Pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay. Dog beds and bowls available on request. Cats and other pets are not permitted.

text: Yes, dogs of any size are allowed, with a maximum of 2 per room [1]. A pet fee of $50 per night per room applies, capped at $200 per stay [1]. Cats and other pets are not permitted [1].

cited_texts.text: Free self-parking. RVs and trailers must use the overflow lot - ask the front desk for directions.

text: Yes, Mountain Lodge offers free self-parking [1]. RVs and trailers must use the overflow lot, and guests can ask the front desk for directions [1].

cited_texts.text: Quiet hours are 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. After a second noise complaint, the Manager on Duty visits the room. After a third complaint, the guest may be asked to leave without a refund (Manager on Duty decision).

text: Quiet hours at Mountain Lodge are 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM [1].

cited_texts.section: Mountain Lodge - Property Policies > Airport Transfers
cited_texts.text: Shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport (AVL): $35 per person one way. Runs hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Book at least 12 hours ahead.

text: Yes. The shuttle runs to and from Asheville Regional Airport (AVL) for $35 per person one way, hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [1].

cited_texts.section: Hotel Group Brand Standards > Check-in and Check-out
cited_texts.text: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM. Standard check-out is 11:00 AM.

text: Early check-in is never guaranteed and depends on whether a room is ready [1]. At Mountain Lodge, check-in before 12 PM costs $25 if the room is ready, and early check-in isn't offered on October weekends because of wedding blocks [2]. Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [3], and the Mountain Lodge fee and earliest time override brand-wide settings [1][2]. Please confirm the current fee with a manager before quoting it to a guest, since my source is a dated staff note.

cited_texts.text: A guest coin laundry on the ground floor is open 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Detergent pods are $2 at the front desk.

text: Yes. Mountain Lodge has a guest coin laundry on the ground floor, open 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM [1]. Detergent pods are $2 at the front desk [1].

text: Items left behind are logged in the Lost & Found binder and kept for 90 days [1]. If the guest wants the item shipped, the shipping cost is the guest's, and you should ship only to an address confirmed from the guest's own email [1]. The sources don't cover how the guest arranges to collect the item, so please check with a manager for that.

text: Yes. The Ridge Loop trail (3 miles) starts behind the lodge, and free trail maps are available at the front desk [1]. Guided hikes run Saturdays at 9:00 AM for $20 per person, and you can book at the front desk by Friday evening [1].
